title: mime-tree: RFC 5322/MIME parser crate
description: Implement the mime-tree crate. Takes raw RFC 5322 bytes, produces ParsedMessage with a ParsedPart tree. Each part carries byte ranges (offset+length) into the caller's buffer. Computes RFC 8621 §4.1.4 views (text_body, html_body, attachments). decode_body_value() decodes on demand. Built on mail-parser (private), encoding_rs, serde. S/MIME parts are opaque leaves.
